Independent reviewer. Both acceptance commands clean after fixes: check_upstream_disjointness.py problems=0 (before and after); verify_new_task.sh berm-coaming => oracle reward=1, nop reward=0, all suite-wide static gates rc=0, exit 0.

FIXED 4 real latent bugs, each of which breaks the task under any uid-1000 trial (the suite spec explicitly says trials 'may run as uid 1000'; the current harbor harness runs as root, so the author's acceptance did not expose them):
(1) The build-time smoke run (golden FAILS at parent -> retained-on-failure) baked /app/src/duckdb_unittest_tempdir root-owned 0755 into the image; the unittest chdirs to /app/src and creates its scratch root there, so every runner invocation as uid 1000 died with 'Failed to prepare temp directory ... EACCES'. Fixed with DUCKDB_TEST_TEMP_DIR_ROOT=/tmp/golden-smoke for the smoke and asserting no leftover; verified uid-1000 runner works.
(2) The tree was root-owned; the project's own post-build step scripts/create_local_extension_repo.py chmods freshly-copied extension files in build/release/repository on EVERY incremental build, so a uid-1000 ninja relink failed EPERM and the agent could not rebuild at all. Fixed with chown -R 1000:1000 /app/src in the SAME RUN as the build (no COW layer duplication; image still 2.55GB).
(3) /tmp/golden.out baked root-owned 644 in the image; the verifier's '> /tmp/golden.out' redirect failed as uid 1000 and its tail then showed the stale parent-failing output -> the verifier false-failed a correct fix. Fixed by removing the file at build and switching the verifier to a fresh mktemp scratch dir for rebuild.log/golden.out/lambdas.out and the pre-fix binary copy.
(4) verifier+oracle planted the golden with cp onto the existing root-owned 644 worktree file (O_TRUNC EACCES as uid 1000); both now rm -f before planting.
Also: removed the origin remote from the working clone (one command fetch affordance gone) and raised build_timeout_sec 3600->5400.

BYPASSES tried, none succeeded (no verifier weakening needed): assume-unchanged/skip-worktree caught by ls-files -v (demonstrated); fix-in-object-store caught by cat-file/rev-list/fsck; /opt/golden tamper caught by sha256 pin; always-REPRO-PASS repro.sh caught by the pre-fix direction at /opt/pre-fix and a copy at a second path; sabotaging /opt/pre-fix yields no reward gain (VALUE rows + repaired-side golden/hidden still gate).
